title: A failed SpiderVideo job never says why — the reason is withheld from client results
summary: For SpiderVideo, error_message in GET /jobs/{id}/results is one fixed sentence ('This job failed. The technical detail is internal, and has been recorded for support — quote this job id…') for every failure: a 404 scene, a missing SpiderMedia bucket, a render timeout, a too-short source and a non-http URL all read identically. Client-facing error text fails CLOSED: only messages on a reviewed allow-list are shown, and no SpiderVideo failure is on it. So an agent cannot diagnose from the result and must not retry blindly (input failures fail the same way every time). Diagnose from the input: verify-video.py preflight opens every URL the renderer will open; for frames, check the source with curl -sI and ffprobe. EXCEPTION since SPI3-70 (2026-09-28): a request the renderer REFUSES fails on its first attempt with '[invalid_video_request] <sentence>', which is shown verbatim — the sentence says what to change. Most such requests are answered earlier, as a 422 at submit.
references: Measured 2026-09-23 against the running api-gateway: client_error_message(<msg>, job_type='spiderVideo') returned the withheld sentence for all 13 SpiderVideo failure shapes tried (asset download, render exit, upload not configured, render timeout, extract_frames bucket, source HTTP / content-type / size, frame count, ffmpeg frame shortfall, duckMusic, URL scheme, upload failure)
app/services/job_error_presentation.py — client_error_message fails closed since SDS-66: a message is shown only if a _CLIENT_VOCABULARY entry vouches for it; WITHHELD_CLIENT_MESSAGE otherwise
SC-465 /test-live 2026-09-22 — a 404 voiceUrl job reached failed after 3 attempts and 'the client sees the sanitized message'

SpiderIQ PR #4337 (SPI3-70, 2026-09-28) — refused renders raise PermanentJobError (should_retry=False) with an authored '[invalid_video_request] ...' sentence; measured: client_error_message shows it verbatim (render R0), while the pre-existing failure shapes stay withheld
